summary.text: Michelle Boyer is a Democratic state representative who has represented Maine House District 123 since December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career experience includes serving as president of Artic Lynx Maternity.

She took office in the Maine House on December 3, 2024, and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
